source: Real stored CHABOIM measurement responses, reduced to the minimum excerpt that preserves the observed structure.

principles: A candidate may only borrow evidence from its own structural scope.
Section headings and recommendation criteria are not business identities by themselves.
Registered business text embedded inside a larger heading or criterion must be normalized to the registered business identity, not the whole phrase.
Evidence from a following table row or sibling section must not confirm the parent heading.
When unique business identity is not established, fail closed to unresolved/non_business rather than inventing a canonical business.

|---|---|---|
| **XPEL Pro 일산백석점** | 일산동구 장항로 70 나동 | XPEL 공식 PRO 인증점. **010-3125-0509** |
| **XPEL Pro 일산로점** | 일산동구 일산로 418 | XPEL 공식 PRO 인증점. **010-3780-4549** |
